topic: Complete wiring: ignition, stop button and throttle sensor
statement: The 2012-2026 CRF150R has no battery and a very small harness: an ignition control module with a 6-pin and a 4-pin connector, an exciter coil and ignition pulse generator on the engine, a direct ignition coil on the plug, a throttle position sensor and the engine stop button. Exciter coil: white and blue. Ignition pulse generator: blue/yellow and green/white. Direct ignition coil: black/yellow from the module and green ground. Throttle position sensor: black/blue, yellow and black at the module (blue, yellow and black on the sensor's own pigtail). Engine stop button: black/white and black/green; pressing it joins the two, and black/green ties into the green ground. Module 6-pin connector wires: green, black, green/white, black/blue, yellow, blue/yellow. Module 4-pin connector wires: blue, black/white, white, black/yellow. Honda's colour letters: Bl black, Y yellow, Bu blue, G green, R red, W white, Br brown, O orange, Lb light blue, Lg light green, P pink, Gr gray.

vals.tps: Bl/Bu, Y, Bl (sensor side Bu, Y, Bl)
vals.icm_6p: G, Bl, G/W, Bl/Bu, Y, Bu/Y

notes: Read from the wiring diagram by eye; check the diagram on the bike before cutting, splicing or back-probing.

source.name: Honda CRF150R competition handbook, wiring diagram pages 2012-2026

topic: Sensor and switch wire colours at the ECM
statement: Wire colours at the ECM on the 2010-2012 CRF250R and CRF450R: 5 V sensor supply red/yellow; sensor ground green/red; throttle position signal yellow/green; intake pressure signal light green/yellow; intake air temperature signal gray/blue; coolant temperature signal pink; No.1 crank sensor blue/yellow; No.2 crank sensor white/yellow; fuel injector black/blue with pink/yellow supply; ignition coil yellow/blue; engine stop switch black/white; warning light white/blue; diagnostic line orange/black. The throttle and intake pressure sensors share the 5 V supply and the sensor ground; the two temperature sensors return on the sensor ground. Honda's colour letters: Bl black, Y yellow, Bu blue, G green, R red, W white, Br brown, O orange, Lb light blue, Lg light green, P pink, Gr gray.
notes: Derived from the ECM pin labels on the wiring diagram.

topic: Harness wire colours at every component
statement: Main-harness wire colours at each plug on the 2017 RM-Z250. Magneto: yellow, yellow (charging) plus green/white and blue (pickup). Regulator/rectifier: yellow, yellow, red, black/white. Condenser: red and black/white. Fuel pump: red/black and red. Injector: gray/white and red. Ignition coil: white/blue and black/white. Engine stop switch: black/yellow and black/white. Throttle position sensor: red/blue, yellow, black/brown. Intake air pressure sensor: red/blue, green/black, black/brown. Intake air temperature sensor: dark green and black/brown. Coolant temperature sensor: black/blue and black/brown. Tip-over sensor: red/blue, brown/white, black/brown. Gear position switch: blue/black, pink, black/white. S-HAC (launch) switch: red, blue/red, white/red, black/white. Optional battery lead: red and black/white. Red/blue is common to the throttle, intake pressure and tip-over sensors, black/brown is the shared sensor return, and black/white is the frame ground. Some parts have a short pigtail in different colours, so read the harness side of the plug. Suzuki's letters: B black, Bl blue, Br brown, Dg dark green, G green, Gr gray, Lg light green, O orange, P pink, R red, W white, Y yellow
notes: Read from the wiring diagram by eye; check the diagram on the bike before cutting, splicing or back-probing.

source.name: Suzuki RM-Z250 2017 owner's service manual, wiring diagram page 5-9

statement: The 2022 RM85 has no battery and one small circuit. The magneto feeds the CDI unit on three wires: black/red, red/white and black/white. The CDI fires the ignition coil on white/blue, and black/white is the ground shared by the CDI and the coil. The engine stop switch is on black/yellow from the CDI and grounds it to the frame when pressed. Suzuki's colour code: B/W black with white tracer, B/R black with red tracer, R/W red with white tracer, B/Y black with yellow tracer, W/Bl white with blue tracer.
notes: Read from the circuit drawing by eye.

source.name: Suzuki RM85 2022 owner's service manual, electrical circuit page 13-2
